_comment: Golden wire shape for POST /api/v1/csat/responses/voice — the capture the survey-IVR leg submits after DTMF collection. Reuses the FROZEN capture shape of src/Verbara.Platform.Api/Dtos/CsatResponseRequest.cs (csat-runner fixtures/csat-response-capture.v1.json) 1:1, extending the channel route/value set with 'voice'; comment is null (DTMF carries no free text). responseToken is the Platform-minted voice-leg token (v1.{payload}.{sig}, HMAC pattern of Pro's HmacCsatReplyTokenSigner). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
